symptom: A Studio Pro radio button group stored with ReadOnlyStyle Text came back from describe → exec as Inherit (JTSBootLogboek Dashboard_Fullscreen_web radioButtons1, Gebruikers_Overview); the same on text box, text area and date picker. describe printed `radiobuttons radioButtons1 (Attribute: IsAanwezig)`; mx check 0 errors before and after. `alter page … set (ReadOnlyStyle: …)` was refused on every built-in widget, check box and data view included
cause: Four writer cases kept the g.SetReadOnlyStyle("Inherit") constant after #490 wired the check box and #550 the data view; the four sdk/pages structs had no field, the builders read nothing and describe's extract/emit covered only those two types. The mutator had no readonlystyle case, so the set fell through to the pluggable path and was refused
insight: A property fixed for one widget type is a signal to grep every SetX("literal") for the same key: #490's finding already named the per-type constants on these four, and they survived two more issues because the fix and the report were both scoped to one type. List the metamodel types that carry the property (grep `func (o *X) SetReadOnlyStyle` in modelsdk/gen) and check each writer, describer and the mutator. Measure the default per type before choosing what describe omits: Inherit on 236/237 text boxes, 57/58 text areas, 51/59 date pickers, 4/4 radio buttons (PedApp + TestApp), unlike the data view's Control. The GetPut test only proves something on a Studio Pro-shaped value: create the page through mxcli, BSON-patch the stored value to Text, then describe → exec must report Unchanged
